scope: Prevent strict DXF serialization from silently dropping the current DWG-only MESH trailing field while recording the unresolved DWG layout discrepancy.

implementation.guard: DRW_Mesh::validateDxfOutput rejects any nonzero unknown value. The DXF MESH writer emits no group for this DWG-only field.
implementation.failureBehavior: The direct writeMesh validation failure leaves the destination empty. dxfRW keeps direct-record write errors sticky, so the corrected retry uses a fresh dxfRW/writer instance. The previous retry-through-the-failed-instance assertion was removed after it exposed this existing contract.

autodeskDxf.supports: The documented AcDbSubDMesh DXF groups include the base mesh, creases, and sub-entity overrides; there is no group for libdxfrw's DWG-only unknown tail.

odaSpecification.result: Searchable text has no AcDbSubDMesh body layout.

libreDwgPeerSchema.interpretation: The undocumented MESH schema declares two trailing one-bit values before common entity handle data. This conflicts with libdxfrw's current trailing BL read. LibreDWG itself labels the fields undocumented/unstable, so this peer schema is a discrepancy lead, not sufficient authority to change the parser.

availablePeerDxf.peerConversion: LibreDWG 0.14 dxf2dwg --as r2004 failed on unrelated EXTRUDEDSURFACE and ASSOCEXTRUDEDSURFACEACTIONBODY records; no DWG output was produced.

coverage: ASCII and Binary typed DXF writers atomically refuse a nonzero unrepresented DWG tail before emitting any bytes.
A corrected zero-tail model writes successfully with a fresh writer in both encodings.
Existing MESH crease value, crease-count, invalid-value, and six-version DWG writer controls still pass.

limitations: No physical modern MESH DWG source was available in the scanned corpus.
The current DWG trailing BL interpretation remains unverified and must not be changed from the peer-only discrepancy without a real source trace or normative layout.
The DXF loss guard does not qualify MESH topology, subdivision, creases, overrides, native display, or 3D meaning.

repositoryState.stagedScope: bounded MESH DWG parse/output profile; DXF loss guards; generated vectors
